data.name: PageDescription
data.value: Create and track tasks for yourself, a colleague, or a position-based pool.

data.name: PoolPositionHint
data.value: The unit is shown next to each position so work is never pooled to the wrong facility.

data.name: SpentHoursReadOnlyHint
data.value: Logged while the work is done — it is always zero on a new task.

data.name: ReviewRequiredHint
data.value: When set, the task goes to a reviewer before it can be completed.

data.name: ReviewerHint
data.value: Required when a review is requested — the review cannot be opened without someone to send it to. Who may actually review is decided by the workflow.

data.name: ApprovalHint
data.value: Approval runs in the workflow engine; the task cannot start until it is granted.

data.name: WatchersHint
data.value: Watchers can see the task but take no action on it.

data.name: ErrorAlreadyClaimed
data.value: Someone else took this task first.

data.name: ErrorNoAccess
data.value: You do not have permission to do this.

data.name: ErrorUnavailable
data.value: The task service could not be reached. Try again.

data.name: EmptyDescription
data.value: Create your first task to see it here and in the Task Center.

data.name: ErrorOccurred
data.value: An error occurred while processing your request.

data.name: ErrorOrganizationUnitUnresolved
data.value: No organization unit could be determined for this task. Ask an administrator to assign you a position or define a root organization unit.

data.name: ErrorPositionNotAssignable
data.value: The selected position cannot receive tasks. Choose an active position.

data.name: ErrorConcurrencyRefreshed
data.value: Someone else changed this task first. The screen now shows the current state.

data.name: ErrorChecklistIncomplete
data.value: A required checklist item is still unticked, so the task cannot be completed.

data.name: ErrorDependencyBlocked
data.value: A task this one depends on is not finished yet, so it cannot move forward.

data.name: ErrorSubtaskBlocked
data.value: A subtask is still open, so this task cannot be completed yet.

data.name: ErrorCommentTaskClosed
data.value: This task is closed, so it can no longer be commented on.

data.name: ErrorCommentTextInvalid
data.value: A comment cannot be empty and must be at most 2000 characters.

data.name: ErrorPlanDateRequired
data.value: A planned date is required to set your personal plan.

data.name: ErrorApprovalPending
data.value: The task is waiting for the approver's decision.

data.name: ErrorCancelNotRequester
data.value: Only the person who requested this task can cancel it. If you do not want the work, return it instead.

data.name: ErrorWaitingReasonRequired
data.value: Say what the task is waiting for.

data.name: ErrorHandoverReasonRequired
data.value: Say why you are handing this task on.

data.name: ErrorReturnNotAssignee
data.value: Only the person the task is assigned to can return it.

data.name: ErrorReassignNotPermitted
data.value: Only the current assignee or the requester can reassign this task.

data.name: ErrorAssigneeNotAssignable
data.value: That person cannot be assigned work. Choose someone from the list.

data.name: ErrorApprovalWaitingEvidence
data.value: The approver has asked for supporting information before deciding.

data.name: ErrorApprovalRejected
data.value: The approval was rejected, so this task cannot continue.

data.name: ErrorApprovalCancelled
data.value: The approval was cancelled, so this task cannot continue.

data.name: ErrorApprovalNotApproved
data.value: The approval is not complete yet, so this step is not allowed.

data.name: ErrorApprovalGateUnavailable
data.value: The approval could not be checked just now, so nothing was changed. Try again shortly.

data.name: AssigneeHint
data.value: Only people who currently hold a position can be assigned work.

data.name: AssigneeEmpty
data.value: No one holds a position yet, so there is nobody to assign to. Ask an administrator to assign positions first.
